2000647632532951106.text:
> be Nikola Mrkšić
> spawn in Serbia, year 1991
> get obsessed with maths and computers
> crack University of Cambridge
> go deep into NLP before it was cool
> completes BA + MSc + PhD at Cambridge
> joins VocalIQ as first engineer in 2011
> build real-world dialogue models
> publish research on spoken dialogue and RL
> Apple acquires VocalIQ for $50M+
> move to Apple Siri team as ML researcher
> work on Siri’s next-gen language models
> 2017 - leave Apple to start PolyAI
> rebuild entire voice infra from scratch
> brutal early days, continue to ship
> raise seed from Amadeus
> PolyAI voice agents go live in call centers
> customers start telling customers
> revenue crosses millions
> 2019 - raise Series A
> ChatGPT launches
> inbound leads jump 4x overnight
> 2022 - raise $40M Series B
> Poly becomes a $260M company
> clients: FedEx, Marriott, Whitbread
> millions of calls handled
> 80% of calls without human in 24+ languages
> 2021 - Forbes 30 Under 30 Europe
> 2024 - raise a whopping $50M Series C
> Nvidia joins the mission
> 2025 - everyone starts building voice AI
> Poly still leading the way
> raise another $86M Series D
> 500ms latency in raven v3
> handles interruptions & emotional cues
> 300+ employees around the globe
> currently valued at ~$750 MILLION

From being born at the exact time when his entire country was falling apart to building a deep-tech startup worth more than half a billion dollars.

Nikola Mrkšić for you, ladies and gentlemen.
